title: Account security
codeHint: 6-digit authenticator code or one-use recovery code
emailSent: If this email is eligible, a message will arrive. Check your inbox and spam folder.
verifyConfirm: Confirm this email address. This link can only be used once.
passwordMismatch: Use at least 8 characters and matching passwords
required: Enable two-factor authentication to administer the platform.
setupHint: Add a time-based account to your authenticator using this secret, then enter its code. Keep the secret private.
saveCodes: Security settings updated. Sign in again. Recovery codes are shown only once; save them in a password manager. Each code works once.
missingKey: The administrator must configure the encryption master key first.
deployIntro: Use the self-hosted panel to install and manage Sub2API or New API on your machine, or connect existing sites. 3API does not rent servers or hardware.
deployEngine: Deploy an engine on your server
deployEngineHint: Follow the official engine guide, initialize the administrator, configure HTTPS and backups. You manage the server and engine upgrades.
connectHint: Enter the HTTPS site URL and management credentials. Start read-only to verify data. Names are editable notes; IDs are generated automatically.
deployPanelHint: You can run this open-source panel on your own server. Back up the panel database and remote relay engines separately.
